主要内容: Broadway Financial Corporation and CF Banc Corporation approved a merger agreement, with CF Banc merging into Broadway. The merger also included approval of an amended and restated certificate of incorporation for Broadway. At the special shareholder meeting, 14,199,351 voting shares were present, representing approximately 73.6% of outstanding shares. Shareholders voted in favor of the merger agreement with 11,173,486 shares. Additionally, shareholders approved converting the company to a public benefit corporation, increasing authorized shares, approving executive compensation, and authorizing private placements of up to 18,474,000 shares at $1.78 per share. The CFO, Brenda J. Battey, confirmed the shareholder votes and completion of the meeting on March 19, 2021.
